programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Deadly Crossbow (The Ryan Family Story) Brett Ryan paves a long road of deception. The serial-lying ex-con hides his bank-robbing past from his fiancé and misleads his family, before a late-night confession to his mother leads to a murder no one could have seen coming.
programme.title: A Secret to Die For

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Goldrush Trail Part 1 Following paranormal investigators Leanne Sallenback, Kelly Ireland and Corine Carey as they begin their travels up British Columbia's famed gold rush trail to explore its history and its hauntings.
programme.title: History's Most Haunted

programme.desc: S01 E09 — Ancient Beasts Re-evaluating what we know about evolution, extinction, and animals' sacred roles. Dig up a Canadian dinosaur that sparks questions about fossilization, meet a prehistoric survivor in China, and see the religious parts crocodiles played in Egypt.
programme.title: Buried Evidence

programme.desc: S01 E09 — Behind the Mask Determining if exotic dancer Mata Hari was a spy or just a wartime scapegoat; solving the riddle of Kaspar Hauser, the boy who appeared from nowhere; trying to identify the Man in the Iron Mask, who died in a French prison without revealing his face.
programme.title: History Unsolved: The Investigation Files

programme.desc: S04 E03 — Desert Mysteries Investigate an abandoned village in the shifting sands on Dubai's outskirts and a collection of inexplicable stone circles in Colombia; a mysterious hilltop tower in Iran and a puzzling purple phenomenon in Chile's Atacama Desert.
programme.title: Mysteries From Above

programme.desc: Stigmata For over 1,000 years, people worldwide claim to develop injuries spontaneously.
programme.title: World's Most Unexplained

programme.desc: UFO Paintings During the renaissance, advances were made in both science and the arts, but many paintings have a mysterious UFO.
programme.title: World's Most Unexplained

programme.desc: S03 E01 — Kids Under Attack A terrifying creature with 1,000 teeth torments Allison Gilson's son; a young boy makes an imaginary friend but discovers it's not the only entity lurking in their new home; a ghost uses a boy to get to his mother.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: S01 E05 Taking a look at strange crafts flying over power plants, airports and the Royal Palace in Sweden, a veteran with supposed UFO-related health issues and footage shown at a US congressional hearing.
programme.title: Evidence of the Unexplained

programme.desc: S03 E06 — Las Vegas UFOs and More A Florida man encounters an elusive Sasquatch; ghost hunters attempt to contact the spirit of a murder victim in Tennessee; a Las Vegas resident captures incredible footage of UFOs soaring through the skies.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S04 E12 — The Dead on the Hill Dig into chilling claims in the coal-mining town of Harlan, where a mysterious woman in white has appeared repeatedly; learn how dread has driven off some hard-boiled locals as the team tries to get to the bottom of these supernatural happenings.
programme.title: Haunted Discoveries

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Indonesian Island Mystery Ancient terraces made of volcanic rock in Indonesia leave their origin still in enigma; hundreds of human skeletal remains are unearthed; a blood-red beach on Hormuz Island ignites speculations; penguin remains are discovered.
programme.title: Mysterious Islands

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Novak: Paramedic Conspiracy? Confront the dark side of paramedic Paul Novak, who hid his deadly impulses beneath a veneer of heroism; explore the evidence that helped investigators determine that this manipulative, unfaithful man brutally murdered his estranged wife, Catherine.
programme.title: Murder by Medic
